stem: Which situation is an example of a person using technology initially designed for the military?

options.label: A
options.text: A teenager pumps gasoline into a new car.

options.label: B
options.text: A man uses a credit card to pay for new purchases.

options.label: C
options.text: A pediatrician vaccinates patients against polio.

options.label: D
options.text: A woman uses a Global Positioning System to navigate around town.
